conventions.convention: ACω is countable choice for sequences of nonempty sets, not full AC or dependent choice. The principal global foliation results explicitly carry ACω.

Tautness requires an embedded smooth closed transversal through every leaf. The empty manifold is taut vacuously but has no transversal; the single-transversal result assumes nonempty compact connected ambient manifold.
A dead-end component is a proper compact saturated embedded region with nonempty leaf boundary and the positive transverse direction inward everywhere on that boundary.
A ≽ B means that a positive transverse segment travels from A to B, with A=B included formally. Formal reflexivity does not supply a genuine positive return.
The strict accessible set uses genuine nonempty positive paths. Its componentwise tautness criterion does not assert N_L=M when M is disconnected.
A vanishing cycle has a jointly C² trace on S¹×[0,1], essential endpoint at t=1, leafwise-null loops for every t<1, and transverse parameter derivatives including one-sided endpoint derivatives.
A nonzero Π class means a nonidentity element of the ordinary leaf fundamental group lying in the limitwise-nullhomotopy subgroup. It is not a nonidentity class in the ordinary limit-cycle quotient.

Leaf compactness and cap continuity are intrinsic, in the plaque topology. Noncompact leaves are not assumed embedded; compact leaves and compact intrinsic subsurfaces have embedded ambient inclusion.

Loop multiplication traverses the first loop first. Forward holonomy is an antihomomorphism; the homomorphic representation uses the reversed loop. Identity-holonomy conclusions are unaffected by reversal.
Boundary orientation is outward-normal-first. With the common inward coorientation, all boundary orientations are the same negative of the induced leaf orientation in dimension three.

The Reeb-component equivalence is a foliated homeomorphism. The constructed torus and solid-torus normal forms are C² diffeomorphisms; arbitrary contracting holonomy germs are not asserted smoothly conjugate.
A leaf's limit set consists of ambient limits of sequences escaping every intrinsic compact subset, equivalently the intersection of closures of tails of a cofinal compact exhaustion.

load_bearing.statement: Assume ACω. Let F be a C² transversely oriented codimension-one foliation of a closed oriented 3-manifold M. If a leaf L has Π¹ʲ(L,x)≠0 for one side j and base point x, then L is compact and is a boundary leaf of a distinct foliation component: there is a mutual-accessibility component S with S∩L=∅ and L⊆∂_M S. The boundary is the ambient topological boundary.

Assume AC_ω and the exact maximal-center-frontier contract. On a separated generic characteristic disk with transverse boundary or regular essential leafwise boundary, finite inner-source-disk search either finds a C² vanishing-cycle trace or selects a null simple one-center/one-saddle frontier whose exact collar-fixed cancellation reduces the full-disk saddle count by one. Iteration terminates in a vanishing cycle; its rank is (total saddles, interior saddles of the current invariant search disk).

Assume ACω, and let F be a C² cooriented foliation of a closed oriented smooth three-manifold. For a fixed-V fence with every positive loop null and simple in its leaf universal cover, and with the sphere-cover alternative excluded, the canonical based Jordan caps form a Hausdorff C² disk bundle over (0,b]. Its evaluation admits coherent regular C² cap development, with the actual reference disk region as source and V-orbit tracks over all positive parameters. If its zero loop is essential, at least one material point has infinite normal clock.

Assume ACω. A compact C² surface, with regular C² boundary allowed, is C² diffeomorphic to a compact smooth surface with smooth boundary. A connected oriented closed such surface with Euler characteristic zero is C² diffeomorphic to T². A compact regular surface region homeomorphic to a closed disk is C² diffeomorphic to D², and any prescribed C² diffeomorphism of its boundary circle can be realized by the disk parametrization. An intrinsically continuous map u:D²→L into a C² surface, C² on an open boundary collar, has arbitrarily close C² approximations agreeing near any smaller closed collar, with a homotopy fixed there; no injectivity or immersion of u is required.

Assume ACω. For a compact C² oriented region W in a closed oriented smooth three-manifold, with oriented C¹ plane bundle E tangent to every boundary component and one common inward transverse direction, the finite sum of boundary Euler characteristics is zero. For a finitely cellulated closed oriented C² surface, a C¹ tangent section with isolated nondegenerate zeros has total index V−E+F.

Assume ACω. In a C² cooriented codimension-one foliation of a closed three-manifold, every intrinsically noncompact leaf meets a positive closed transversal. The transversal can be chosen to avoid any specified finite family of distinct compact leaves. Conversely, absence of such a transversal forces intrinsic compactness.

Assume ACω. For a smooth cooriented codimension-one foliation on a closed manifold M, the strict positive accessible set N_L is open and saturated, and L meets a closed transversal iff L⊆N_L. Tautness is equivalent to every N_L equalling the ambient component containing L. If L meets no closed transversal, its accessible closure is a proper compact manifold with nonempty boundary consisting of finitely many compact leaves including L, with positive transverse directions inward everywhere; all boundary leaves meet no closed transversal. The region construction also holds for C² foliations and C² transversals.

On the original compact torus leaf, a nonzero Π^j class has a primitive embedded representative with the same Π^j property; its sufficiently short fixed-flow fence is an embedded annulus and each positive boundary bounds an actual embedded disk in its leaf.

The primitive Π cap block is an embedded solid torus after attaching its collar to the original leaf, and its foliation is foliated-homeomorphic to the standard Reeb component, with continuous inverse at the boundary.

Assume ACω. Let F be a C² cooriented codimension-one foliation of a 3-manifold, and let h:D²→M be a disk map in relative generic position. Suppose either h restricted to ∂D² is a closed transversal, or h(∂D²) is a loop in one leaf representing a nonzero class of that leaf. Then F admits a vanishing cycle.

Assume ACω. A C² transversely oriented codimension-one foliation of a closed oriented 3-manifold contains a Reeb component if some leaf inclusion is noninjective on π₁ or some closed transversal is nullhomotopic in the ambient manifold. Equivalently, a Reebless foliation under these hypotheses has π₁-injective leaves and essential closed transversals.

concerns.concern: Proof 1.1 says that if H(t)=t, 'the finite-generator graph lemma [F2] produces a compact one-sheeted nearby leaf.' The cited collar-graph Statement assumes the nearby leaf is already compact; it does not state this existence implication. Its Proof 3.1 contains the finite gluing construction needed to close the use, but the consumer should explicitly invoke that construction with both generator holonomies fixing t.

The Statement says the fixed plaque patch lies in 'all sufficiently late caps.' Proof 1.1 selects and adjusts recurrence times s_n, and Proof 3.1 establishes containment for the corresponding subsequence of caps. Specify 'all sufficiently late caps in the adjusted recurrence sequence'; the proof does not establish containment at every sufficiently small positive family parameter. The downstream nesting argument uses the sequence.

F1 attributes 'one more center than saddle in a one-quadrant inner disk' to lem-characteristic-disk-center-saddle-index-count, whose Statement requires a regular boundary that is leafwise or everywhere transverse. The exact one-quadrant homoclinic count is instead supplied by lem-one-quadrant-homoclinic-disk-has-one-more-interior-center-than-saddle, already used through the nested-search supplier. Make this attribution explicit.

The Statement assumes 'the exact maximal-center-frontier contract' without defining that phrase. Its characteristic-disk consumer quotes an unconditional full-disk result. Proof 1.1 reconstructs the relevant one-saddle frontier classification, so this appears to be an interface-wording issue; state the contract explicitly and identify where it is discharged before the downstream application.

seams_checked.note: The current same-V cap products, actual collar-range conditions, C² transport, Jordan-disk qualifications and separated-singularity uses match their suppliers. One citation attribution is inaccurate: the frontier-rank item's F1 assigns the one-quadrant homoclinic count to the regular-boundary disk-index supplier. The correct special-case supplier was opened and is available through nested search. No reverse citation to an owned item was found in the supplier page's items.

Identity-holonomy and path-independence uses preserve intrinsic leafwise homotopy and fixed endpoint transversals. The representation uses reversed loops under traversal-order multiplication; forward return maps are used only with the corresponding path convention or for identity assertions. The C¹ adapter supplies the C²-atlas interpretation. No reverse citation to an owned item was found.

Compact-leaf embeddedness is intrinsic; smooth coorientation and Reeb-model uses retain their scope. The mapping-torus action is (x,t)↦(f(x),t+1), and the example correctly closes a graph with a(1)=f(a(0)); the supplier's suspension return map remains f⁻¹. Stronger C² spherical stability is proved locally rather than quoted from the full-AC global theorem. No reverse citation to an owned item was found.
